story:
AmeriStar Maids is a house cleaning and maid service based in Dallas, Pennsylvania, serving the Back Mountain, the Wyoming Valley, Mountain Top, and the surrounding communities throughout Luzerne County. We have spent more than ten years in this industry, and in that time we have built the company around one idea: we specialize in creating free time for busy people.

We love providing joy and freedom to our clients. Having a trusted house cleaner committed to your home liberates your time and alleviates your stress. We take your dreaded chore list and turn it into more hours spent with friends and family. Instead of coming home to clutter, you come home to a beautiful and neat living space — and a home that is genuinely healthier for the people in it.

We know you do not want to let just anyone into your home. That is why we have carefully assembled a team of dependable housekeepers rather than hiring to fill a schedule. Every member is fully bonded and insured, carries company-provided workers' compensation, and has been through a thorough screening process to confirm they are qualified, trustworthy, and hardworking. Your home is assigned to one of them and stays with them: one maid, same maid, every time.

We are also proud of our partnership with Cleaning for a Reason, a non-profit organization that arranges free home cleanings for the families of women, men, and children undergoing cancer treatment. We donate thousands of dollars annually in free home cleaning services so that these individuals can concentrate fully on their recovery.
